---
title: "Example report (R)"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

data <- tibble(
  category = c("A", "A", "B", "B", "C", "C"),
  value = c(3, 5, 6, 8, 2, 4)
)
data |> group_by(category) |> summarise(value = mean(value))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = category, y = value)) +
  geom_point()
```
